subject.title: [Bug]: plugin runtime subagent.run from before_dispatch does not trigger subagent_delivery_target or final external delivery

question: Should plugin-runtime `api.runtime.subagent.run()` support requester-visible completion delivery, and if so should it be opt-in or the default?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the choice changes public Plugin SDK semantics and could make existing background plugin tasks start sending user-visible final messages.

options.title: Add Opt-In Completion Delivery
options.body: Introduce an explicit completion-delivery option or mode that registers requester/origin metadata and runs the existing announce plus `subagent_delivery_target` path only when requested.

options.title: Make Completion Delivery Default
options.body: Treat plugin-runtime subagent runs like core subagent spawns by default, accepting the compatibility risk that current background tasks may start producing external final messages.

options.title: Document Background-Only Semantics
options.body: Keep `api.runtime.subagent.run()` detached/background-only and update docs to require plugins to poll and send their own deferred results.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Completion Delivery
recommendation.body: Introduce an explicit completion-delivery option or mode that registers requester/origin metadata and runs the existing announce plus `subagent_delivery_target` path only when requested.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/plugin-subagent and announce-delivery commits plus prior API review context make this the strongest routing candidate for the default/API decision.
